title: Chef José Andrés' 40-Second Microwave Mayo Omelette
originalTitle: Chef José Andrés' 40-Second Microwave Mayo Omelette
ingredients: 1 generous tbsp full-fat mayonnaise (emulsified oil + egg yolk keeps the egg soufflé-fluffy in the microwave)
1 tsp softened butter or olive oil (for greasing the dish)
Pinch of flaky sea salt, freshly cracked black pepper, and chopped chives
instructions: Crack 1 large egg into a bowl, add 1 generous tablespoon of mayonnaise, and whisk vigorously with a fork or whisk until light, frothy, and full of tiny air bubbles.
Coat a shallow microwave-safe plate or wide ramekin with 1 tsp butter or olive oil and pour in the whisked egg-mayo mixture.
Microwave on high for 30 to 40 seconds until puffed and softly set, fold in half like a French omelette, and finish with chives and black pepper.
